page.layout: One page of text in a single column; no marginal notes. Running head at top centre; page number 307 at top right. Handwritten "158" in the right margin is not printed and is left out. Signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: trió præpositâ, vel omissâ, plura nos in De linguâ Hebraicâ.
Ξιφος οξιφος ; a Knife. Vide supra.
Ὄρνις, avis, in genere, quævis. Interdum speciali͏ùs, de gallinaceo genere, a heme, Anglis, avis ardea : hen, gallina.
Οἶκος, vel ... ; tectum, culmen ; a roofe.

Ὀλολυγμα, & ὀλολυγμὸς, lamentatio, ploratus, planctus ; a dirge : scio vulgò ex solemni in his (ut aiunt) sacris verbo dirige originem repeti. Quàm probabiliter id dicatur, melius judicarem, si ante oculos illæ formulæ: Nam quòd ad Deum dirigantur istæ preces, nimis id dilutum est, cùm non illæ magis, quod sciam, quàm quævis aliæ: Præterea movet me, quòd in nullâ aliâ linguâ his sacris inditum ab hoc dirige nomen reperiam.
Ὀρθρος, diluculum, tempus antelucanum, proprie ; rath, rathest.

page.notes: The Greek words in the entries for Ξιφος, Οἶκος and Ὀνχὴ are uncertain and marked as such where I could not read them letter by letter. The handwritten "158" in the margin is not printed text and is omitted. The catchword at the foot is uncertain.
